title: prunus pseudocerasus subvar. parvifolia
intro: Prunus pseudocerasus subvar. parvifolia, commonly known as Chinese wild plum, is a plant species in the Rosaceae family. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which provide several health benefits, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities. The therapeutic actions of Chinese wild plum include supporting immune function, reducing fever and inflammation, and treating digestive issues. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
